novel_features.name: Bulk detail enrichment
novel_features.description: Refresh stored listings from Zimmo, resumably: status changes, price history, EPC, flood and planning flags, GPS.
novel_features.rationale: Detail fields live only on the per-listing endpoint; the local store tracks what is missing.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Run it before peb-trap or motivated so their filters see detail fields.

novel_features.name: Cross-portal match
novel_features.description: Find the Immoweb or Immovlan twin of a Zimmo listing and the price gap between portals.
novel_features.rationale: Joins the Zimmo store with the immoweb-pp-cli and immovlan-pp-cli stores using Zimmo's exact address.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Dedupe leads across Belgian portals without refetching anything.

novel_features.name: Sold comps
novel_features.description: Sold or rented listings around one property with median €/m² and the subject's gap to it.
novel_features.rationale: Zimmo exposes SOLD listings with rooftop GPS; no portal UI ranks them by distance with stats.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Median sold €/m² around the subject and its gap to it; Zimmo lists few sold properties, so the result widens to the postcode when thin.

novel_features.name: PEB trap
novel_features.description: Energy-poor stored listings (EPC F/G or high kWh/m²), rented ones first with their rent, showing Zimmo's renovation-obligation flag.
novel_features.rationale: Numeric EPC and renovation obligation are Zimmo-only fields filled by enrich.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Surfaces owners under pressure to sell.

novel_features.name: Underpriced vs commune
novel_features.description: Rank stored for-sale houses and apartments by discount to their commune's €/m² (viager, whole buildings and service flats skipped).
novel_features.rationale: Joins the local store with Zimmo's per-commune €/m² series.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Turns thousands of listings into a short list of apparent bargains.

novel_features.name: Gross rental yield
novel_features.description: Gross rental yield of sale listings: the published rent when let, otherwise rentals of similar surface in the same postcode and type.
novel_features.rationale: Pairs sale listings with RENTED/TO_RENT €/m² from the same commune and bedroom band.

novel_features.name: Motivated seller score
novel_features.description: Rank listings by seller pressure: days on market, total price cut, re-listing, EPC.
novel_features.rationale: Uses Zimmo's full price history and exact address to spot re-listings.

narrative.headline: Belgian real estate from Zimmo with exact addresses, sold comps, commune prices per m² and a local store for deal sourcing.
narrative.value_prop: Search Zimmo's listings, including sold and rented ones, from the terminal with no account. Listings you find are stored locally, which powers comps, underpriced, peb-trap, yield and motivated, and same-as matches them against the immoweb-pp-cli and immovlan-pp-cli stores.
narrative.auth_narrative: No account or key. The CLI mints Zimmo's anonymous web token automatically (valid 24 hours) and caches it.

quickstart.comment: Check connectivity; the anonymous token is minted on first use
Resolve a postcode to Zimmo place ids
Read one listing in full by its Zimmo code
Commune price per m² with its monthly history

troubleshoots.fix: Run the command again: the CLI re-mints Zimmo's anonymous token automatically; set ZIMMO_TOKEN only to force one

troubleshoots.symptom: curl gets a Cloudflare 403 but the CLI works
troubleshoots.fix: Expected: Cloudflare challenges curl's TLS fingerprint, not Go's
Zimmo only shows listings agencies mark as sold; widen --radius or --months, or use prices for the commune €/m²

troubleshoots.symptom: peb-trap, underpriced, motivated or same-as return nothing
troubleshoots.fix: They read the local store: store listings first with `zimmo-pp-cli watch run --all`; a one-off `zimmo-pp-cli find --postcode 1050` also works. `sync` does not load listings

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI for Belgian property search, valuation and deal sourcing from Zimmo: listings for sale or rent, sold comparables, commune price per m², agencies, and daily watches. It pairs with immoweb-pp-cli and immovlan-pp-cli for cross-portal work.
anti_triggers: Contacting agencies or submitting forms on Zimmo
Managing a Zimmo account, favourites or saved searches on the website
